title: Taking up banjo and joining the steamer Capitol
summary: He joined Chris Kelly's rough band, learned banjo in two weeks, and replaced Johnny St. Cyr on the steamer Capitol, trips to St. Louis.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Working the Streckfus riverboats with Fate Marable

blocks.x: Right. Yes. Heard they played a lot of blues. Is that right? A lot of blues. Yes, that's right.

Well, then I was, when I went with him, I went on banjo. I had just taken up banjo. Well, I had taken up banjo. Uh, banjo player on the Seema Capitol. He was to leave. I can't call his name. I just, uh, well, I had taken up banjo.

That's right. Johnny Sincere. And I bought a banjo in two weeks' time and went on the Capitol and I made a week's trip with him, catching on, you know. So, he left and I went on way with the boat. It's two weeks I had taken up my banjo. Uh, that was $150 Viga. Banjo. Viga made banjo.
